title: mitchella repens subsp. undulata
intro: Mitchella repens subsp. undulata, commonly known as Squawberry or Twinflower, is a plant species in the Rubiaceae family, native to North America. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include treating menstrual cramps, reducing inflammation, and improving cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Squawberry are attributed to its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and improve sleep quality. The bioactive constituents of Mitchella repens subsp. undulata include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
